title: AUX-013 Parent Live Completion Authority Repair
purpose: Repair the supervisor Mission Runner so generated-only live queue items cannot be marked completed by a writer child before the parent-owned validation and item-live gates succeed.

queueItems.label: AUX-013
queueItems.title: Enforce parent live completion authority
allowedActions: make the parent supervisor the only source of truth for generated-only live queue item completion
defer or remove writer-authored status:completed/completedBy for generated-only live items before parent item-live validation runs
restore completion in the tracked queue only after parent validation and parent item-live validation succeed
add command-smoke coverage for both parent live success and parent live failure after a writer child prematurely marks the queue item completed
preserve the existing writer parser parent-finalize recovery path for planned-path edits
do not retry M219 or run live CEP/AE validation as part of this support repair
forbiddenActions: commit the dirty M219 product/live lane changes
use Local/Ollama, OpenRouter, deterministic fallback, or external-provider planner validation
install or run any external AO runtime
create a branch, worktree, push, PR, GitHub issue, or GitHub Action
change dependencies, package manifests, or package locks

reviewerTasks.prompt: Review AUX-013. Block if generated-only live item completion can still be finalized by a writer child before the parent item-live gate succeeds, or if a parent item-live failure can leave a tracked queue item marked completed.

Review AUX-013 support boundaries. Block if the repair commits M219 product/live lane changes, runs live CEP/AE, uses Local/Ollama/OpenRouter/deterministic fallback, changes dependencies, creates branch/worktree/push/PR/GitHub work, or weakens parser parent-finalize safety.

commitPolicy.message: fix: enforce parent live completion authority

completedBy.note: Added parent-owned generated-only live completion authority to the Mission Runner. The parent now defers writer-authored queue completion before item-live validation and writes completedBy only after parent validation and item-live gates pass. Command-smoke coverage proves both live success and live failure after premature writer completion.
